notes.title: ☀️ Lynked Beach Bums Update Now Live!
notes.notes:
The Lynked Beach Bums Update has arrived, and it’s packed with new challenges, fresh rewards, and a whole lot of beachside chaos. Whether you’re a seasoned member of the Banner of the Spark or just diving in, this update brings something for everyone looking for a little fun in the sun!


🌴 Summer Updates
🎥 Dev Livestream
🎁 Twitch Drops

🌴 Summer Content Has Landed
Challenge Mode has leveled up with 6-Star and 7-Star tiers and a fresh new UI to help you track progress and rewards. Conquer these tougher missions to unlock rare cosmetics in the Banner of the Spark Shop. 


Summer features include:
Seasonal weapons and cosmetics

New summer-themed characters

Special missions (one-shot & replayable)

Collectible beach currency you can spend in two new shops

A full suite of camp decorations to transform your biome into a vacation getaway



Take on three new 5-Star expeditions—one per biome—and start earning rewards now. Full details in the Patch Notes.


🎥 Developer Livestream Incoming
Join us today at 11 AM PT on Steam for a special Developer Livestream, where we’ll share behind-the-scenes insights, gameplay breakdowns, and answer community questions.

👉 Watch on Steam
📅 Date: June 26 (TODAY)
🕚 Time: 11 AM PT

Whether you're here for the new challenges, slick cosmetics, or a peek behind the scenes—this is the stream for you. Come hang out!


🎁 Twitch Drops
Earn exclusive in-game rewards by tuning in to Lynked streams on Twitch! Twitch Drops are now live—watch to collect limited-time cosmetics while celebrating the new update. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/be7d0d0759ca2fe48abf3d4ad08a5df30022815c.png"]

Learn more about account linking in our Twitch Drops blog.


☀️ Fun in the Sun with the Resistance 
Grab your buddies, bots, and beach balls because the Lynked Summer Update is LIVE NOW. Jump in game, tune-in to the developer livestream to start earning your Twitch Drops! 


Sit back, stay a while, and soak in the summer. Even the resistance needs a little rest and relaxation.

notes.title: Patch Notes: Beach Bums
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/161ec7f49d00291b4f0d82d386d525caf397d354.png"]

The newest seasonal event in Lynked is here! Check out the patch notes below to learn all about this summer-themed update: 

 
WHAT’S NEW 
Challenge Mode 

All mission difficulties can now be increased by 2 additional threat levels (up to a maximum of 7, previously 5.) 

Rewards scale up and combat becomes more challenging as players raise the threat level. 

Threat Boosting is now available on all combat missions. 

Using the Skip function (available if the mission was previously completed with a friend) grants only the base level of rewards. 

New mission modifiers introduce unique and varied challenges. 

 

Spark Sanctum 

A new shop available in the Sparkhold after Chapter 6—access it by speaking to any of the four Banner of the Spark members. 

Purchase exclusive items including weapons, cosmetics, and decor. 

Gold variants of all Buddy weapons. 

Weapon Brands/Icons backpacks. 

New Bot Masks for all Unibots. 

Four new Liveries—each themed after one member of the Banner of the Spark. 

Gold versions of the statues earned by meeting each Banner member. 

Gold action figures of all four Banner members. 

  

UI Updates 

The threat level gauge now includes 6th and 7th pips, visible anywhere the gauge appears. 

A Mission Info dropdown has been added to the party banner in town when launching missions—it displays difficulty and rewards. 

Expandable/collapsible Mission Info UI added within missions. 

Updated fishing minigame UI. 

The Player Equipment screen now shows the player’s weapon, equipped weapon’s Special Attack, equipped Spark Power, Support-Lynk, Wyre upgrades, and Wyre abilities. 

 

Seasonal Event: Beach Bums 

Includes 3 combat missions, 2 non-combat fishing quests, and 2 repeatable expeditions. 

New Weapons: The Refresher (Blaster) and Shade Shank (Spear.) 

New Cosmetics: Sunhat, Captain’s Cap, Snorkel, Pink Flamingo backpack, Life Preserver backpack, Beach Tote backpack, and Bot Masks themed after the two new Unibots: Grazza and Dazza. 

New Decor: 28 new summer-themed decor items, plus 2 new Unibot statues themed after Grazza and Dazza. 

Event Currency (Crypto Conch) is earned by completing event-specific missions, collecting combat drops, digging up event-only sand piles on the beach in town, and selling Gillibots to Grazza.

notes.title: Patch Notes: 1.0 Launch
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/a5347fe7f714cfc3478e120bab7f2de7bb223ad8.png"]


Lynked's Early Access is coming to an end, with the game officially launching into 1.0 on Steam, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S! Thank you to everyone who’s been part of our development journey so far—check out the patch notes below for a full breakdown of what’s included in this update:


WHAT'S NEW
Now on Consoles: In addition to PC (Steam), Lynked is now available on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S.

Complete Story: Chapters 5-9 of the main campaign are now available! Discover the fate of the lost Banner of the Spark leader: Brymm and face the ultimate threat behind the Combot Network.

New Side Content: Take on special challenges from each member of the Banner of the Spark, unlock unique cosmetics, and earn your place among the ranks of this elite group.

New Region: Ascend the Voidspyre—an ever-shifting tower deep in Combot territory. Take on terrifying new enemies and thrilling boss battles. With procedurally generated rooms, no two encounters are ever the same.

New Difficulty Modes: Two new options—Story Mode and Cozy Mode—are now available for players seeking a more relaxed experience, while still enjoying Lynked’s combat at their own pace. Both modes are fully supported in single-player and multiplayer.

New Support-Lynks and Spark Powers: Unleash ultimate attacks with your favorite Banner of the Spark bots and learn powerful new flame abilities from a legendary newcomer.

New Enemies: Take on 5 new bosses, 9 regular enemies, 9 elites, and 6 mini-boss variants! This update also introduces 9 deadly new traps.

Weapon Brands:

Void Weapons: Deal increased damage but carry a negative-effect Weapon Mod.

New Weapons: Added to the Combot and Unibot brands, including unique Banner of the Spark-themed weapons inspired by Tehra, Corlia, Ghust, and Brymm.

New Weapon Core: Slow enemy movement and attacks with the brand-new Sludge Core.

New Weapon Mods: Unlock 25 new Weapon Mods as you progress through the main campaign.

New Free Cosmetics: Stylish Streetwear and Ninja outfits are now available, alongside a new Fishing Beanie.

New Helmet: Finally complete your Gillibot collection by fishing for the critters found only in the Voidspyre. Catch every single Gillibot to unlock a new special headwear.

Achievements: Lynked now fully supports achievements—perfect for the completionists and Trophy/Achievement hunters out there.

Plus, a ton of optimization and performance improvements.



Whether you’re a returning player from Steam or diving into Lynked for the first time on consoles, we want to thank you for your support. We’re incredibly excited for you to experience everything the game has to offer and look forward to continue building and improving it with our community post-launch!

notes.title: Lynked: Banner of the Spark Gears Up for Full Release on May 22, 2025
notes.notes:
Hi, everyone! We have some big news that we’re finally ready to share with you.The team is thrilled to announce that Lynked will be coming out of early access for 1.0 launch on May 22, 2025!

[previewyoutube=ozF5rFIR4Ck;full][/previewyoutube]
If you haven’t had a chance to try Early Access yet, let us get you up to speed: In Lynked, you are a member of the resistance that will rebuild, battle, and uncover the past in a world reclaimed by rogue machines. With the help of your friendly, neighborhood Unibots, you'll piece together a new home while unraveling their unique quirks, histories, and quests. This adventure isn’t just about survival—it’s about discovery. Every battle fuels your journey, and every structure you build strengthens your next fight.

Read on to learn about early access, our most recent update, and what features you can expect from our official launch.

A Soulspark for adventure 
Our official launch on May 22, 2025, introduces five new chapters that expand the story with 40 additional missions, new weapons, five powerful bosses, and the brand-new Voidspyre Biome. You’ll uncover deeper gameplay and strategy with 25 new weapon mods, fresh enemy types, and the special 10-part sidequest: “Banner of the Spark.” 

A journey through early access, together
We’ve been pouring our hearts into this world, and we can’t wait for you to dive into our 1.0 release. Throughout early access, we’ve partnered with our community to build Lynked together. Earlier this year, we released Frostbye– an update that expanded on our weather systems to expand on town life and building while making the environment feel more alive. 

Today, we released the  "Buddy Up!" patch, which brings even more ways to connect with your Unibot allies. Recruit up to 168 Unibots as Battle Companions, and upgrade your home base with a fully equipped kitchen for Chef Brot—where you can cook meals to boost your battle ranks.

Rebuild together in Lynked on May 22, 2025!
We’re just getting started, and we can’t wait to take this journey with you. Over the next few months, we’ll be sharing guides, tips, and behind-the-scenes insights from the devs to help you gear up for the resistance.

If you haven’t yet, jump into Early Access and start building your squad! Join us on Steam & Discord to stay in the loop, swap strategies, and be part of shaping the adventure ahead.

💙 See you in town!

Fuzzy Bot Team

notes.title: Patch Notes: Buddy Up!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/2dcc980d954f3fc53129b2adc79e746614463139.png

Another major update has arrived in Lynked: Banner of the Spark! Meet a flavorful new character and recruit your favorite Unibot Residents into battle with Buddy Up! Check out the patch notes below for all the spicy details:

WHAT'S NEW
 Chef Brot Arrives: After a long journey perfecting his culinary skills, the legendary chef is ready for his biggest challenge yet—feeding the Resistance! 

 Chef will appear in your town after completing Lynked's Chapter One.
 Build his Kitchen and complete all-new requests to unlock fresh food Recipes.
 Working with Chef unlocks a new cosmetic (Chef’s Hat,) a new Resonator (Chef’s Sound Mixer,) and a devastating new Support-Lynk: Soup’s Up!
 Chef’s arrival introduces two new systems: Cooking and Battle Companions.

 Battle Companions: Bring your favorite Unibot Residents into missions! 

 Choose up to two Unibots when playing solo (Single Player or Multiplayer) or one when adventuring with friends (Multiplayer.)
 Battle Companions will have a unique fighting style depending on their body type! Small ones strike with fast attacks, Medium-sized bots deal AOE damage, and larger ones unleash slow, but powerful, strikes.
 Unibots have their own Spark Powers—raise shields, heal allies, or blast Combots from afar. Form a team that fits your playstyle!
 Battle Companions can revive players and each other and have unique “throw effects.” Grab a Unibot with your Wyre, charge up a throw, and unleash destruction!

 Cooking: Discover your Unibot Residents’ favorite Recipes and serve them meals to increase their Rank!

 Ranking up Battle Companions boosts their stats, enhances their Spark Powers, and unlocks special décor items.
 Completing Chef’s requests unlocks new Recipes requiring unique ingredients—harvest crops, flowers, Smeats, Gillibots, and Combot parts to master your cooking skills.
 Unibots now have Favors requiring specific dishes—keep your pantry stocked!
 Short on ingredients? Check Chef’s Produce Stand for a rotating selection of items.

 Haptic Feedback: Controller and Steam Deck players—rumble support is now available! (Can be disabled in Options.)
 New Weapons: Completing Chef’s Recipe Book unlocks food-themed weapons! Expand your arsenal with:

 Dough-Cut (Ringblade)
 Pepper-Box (Blaster)
 Marty McFries (Battleboard)
 Gronion Glaive (Basher)
 Rock n’Roll (Resonator)
 Gladius Carota (Sword)
 Smeat Kabob (Spear)


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/f104a4b69bbbb5b1a935a09359f110cd1ea201c5.png
GAMEPLAY CHANGES
 Weapon Drops: Chest loot now matches the Class of your equipped weapon. (The option for randomized loot remains available in the game's Settings.)
 Miniboss Tuning: Reduced the “Miniboss” Combot encounters to two waves. 

 Large enemies will no longer spawn alongside Minibosses.
 Slightly reduced damage dealt by Minibosses.

 Future Brand Weapons: Now come with a Speedy + Level 2 Core by default 

 Fixed: Fist & Spear weapons can now roll Speed upgrades.
 Fixed: Spark Powers now recharge at the Campsite.

 New Contract: Unlocking a new Unibot Support-Lynk grants you a contract at Dime's Bounty Board, featuring new Support-Lynk challenges with rewards to spend at their respective shops.

notes.title: Patch Notes: Frostbyte Update
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/8f1b626af4865f3543a383b27462bbde76b6fa75.png


FROSTBYTE IS HERE! 

The first major content update for Lynked: Banner of the Spark during Early Access has arrived! Check out the patch notes below for all the frosty details: 

 
WHAT'S NEW

 Dynamic Weather System: Every four real-time hours, there's a chance of snow or rain in town. 

 New Collectible Critters: Snowy and rainy days bring out special Gillibots and Bitibots to find! Collect them all to receive blueprints of the new holiday-themed weapons. 

 Frosteau Arrives in Town: Meet a mysterious Unibot searching for his missing Cryo Crystals. Help him through limited-time event missions to unlock exclusive rewards. 

 Event-exclusive Rewards: Collect Cryo Crystals in town or during event missions to trade at Frosteau's Shop for unique weapons, decor, and cosmetics. 

 Rare Event Tokens: Dig through snow or leaf piles in town for Red Envelopes that can be exchanged at Frosteau's Shop for a large sum of Cryo Crystals! 

 New Weapon Core: Imbue your weapons with icy attacks to freeze and shatter Combots with the new Freeze Core. 

 New Holiday-themed Weapons: Destroy Combots with new festive weapons, including the Snowing Star (Ringblade,) The Sledder (Battleboard,) Double Dragonhead (Breacher,) and Candy Payne (Basher.) Even more will be added to the lineup in future updates. 

 Snowball Fight: Unibot Residents can now request Favors involving snowball fights. Hit them, and they’ll retaliate—you might even spark a town-wide clash! 

 The Snowball Effect: Intercept runaway Bitibots or catch Gillibots midair by tossing a snowball to momentarily freeze them in place! 

 Multiplayer Ping System: Highlight items like Armor, Health, chests, and weapons during combat to guide your teammates. 

 Updated BuddyOS: Explore the new Armory tab, which showcases Weapons and Weapon Mods. View stats and details of your collected gear in one place. 

 Weapons & Mods Filtering: Prevent specific gear from showing up as loot during mission runs directly from the Armory. 

 Expanded Combat Areas: Day/night variants and new remixes for mission maps essentially double the playable areas within existing biomes. 

 Updated Character Customization Screen: Players can now click on the new “Selfie Mode” option to hide the UI for a better view of the character and outfit. 

 New Character Customization Options: Personalize your character further with eight new eyebrow styles. 

 Enhanced Town Management in Multiplayer: Hosts can now customize town permissions, including max player count and who can build or harvest resources. Choose from three permission levels for players who join your town: 

     Friends: Full access to Build Mode and resource harvesting. 
     Guests: Full access to Build Mode but no resource harvesting. 
     Tourists: No access to Build Mode or resource harvesting. 

 Steam Deck Improvements: This update brings significant enhancements to improve Lynked's compatibility with the Steam Deck, including controller and touchscreen support, reworked default settings, and optimization improvements. While this is an ongoing effort during Early Access, we encourage players to share feedback or contact player support if any major issues arise. 

 Changes to Chapters 1 & 2: We've optimized the flow of the introductory chapters in Lynked. If you encounter any issues with the early missions in the game, please don't hesitate to leave feedback or to contact our player support. 

 [hr][/hr]
GAMEPLAY CHANGES
  
 Spark Powers: Charges now carry over between rooms (no auto-refill) and recharging stops when rooms are cleared. 

 Weapon Specials: Begin fully charged at the start of new combat rooms.  

 Spear Special (Flurry Strike): Rebalanced damage and reduced the number of hits.  

 Battleboard Special (Ten Eighty): Damage has been increased.  

 Electricity (Status Effect): Reduced the duration of the shocked status effect on players.  

 Chest Drops: Chests are now more likely to provide weapons matching the class of the one currently equipped.  

 Player Armor: Max Armor reduced to three pips, with new "Starting Armor" upgrades in the Sparkhold allowing Max Armor to increase to five pips.  

 Town Tools: Drastically improved responsiveness and speed.  

 Town Economy: Slightly adjusted for better balance.  

 Weapon Mods: Fixed exploits and retuned.  

 [hr][/hr]
BUG FIXES
  
 Improved Framerate (AMD): Players using AMD GPUs should notice better performance.  

 Combo Counter Fix: The combo counter now correctly registers enemies that self-destruct.  

 Cosmetic Items: Fixed the visuals and icons of certain items for improved consistency.  

 Spark Power Descriptions: Corrected description text for certain Spark Powers.  

 Spark Hunter (Weapon Mod) Fix: Now properly increases the number of Soulsparks dropped by enemies. Happy hunting!  

 Decor Categories: Certain decor items are now sorted into the correct categories.  

 Stash Error Message: Fixed the error message that appears when attempting to stash un-stashable items.  

 3D Icon Replacement: Some Unibots and Residents now use the correct 2D art for their icons.  

 Combat Mission Fixes:  
  
     Resolved issues with enemies spawning in inaccessible areas.  
     Fixed a bug where enemies knocked out of bounds wouldn't get KOed.  
  
 Town Fixes: Addressed areas where Residents could be thrown into but wouldn’t respawn.  

 UI Improvements: Various UI issues have been fixed.

notes.title: Developer Update #3: Updated Roadmap
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/34c85d2d7c2f6bf445aa3bf219c55a8585871608.png

Hi, everyone! Last month, we shared our first roadmap for Lynked Early Access, outlining plans for the December Winter Update and some additional content originally slated for early next year. As is often the case with game development, this update turned out to be a bit more ambitious than we initially planned! To ensure we can add more features, incorporate community feedback, and deliver a polished experience, the team has decided to move the release date to early 2025. 

To make up for the delay, players who log in between December 19, 2024, and January 6, 2025, will receive a special holiday-themed weapon—the Candy Payne Basher! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/974ac9323db25960acdd27c71fc7b1b896ea7a8a.png

Curious about what’s in the update? Here’s a recap, plus some new details:


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/642daa265cf1fb6ffffcbfafeaa387ee0b60339a.png
NOW COMING IN EARLY 2025 

 The weather in town is changing: Snow and rain introduce unique Bitibots hiding in snowdrifts and dry leaf piles. Plus, catch new Gillibots exclusive to chilly or rainy weather! 
 A new Unibot arrives in town: Help this mysterious newcomer collect resources to return home! Complete new missions and exchange special tokens for event-exclusive decor, cosmetics, and more. 
 New Weapon Core: A fifth elemental attack is on the way, joining Fire, Hack, Corrosion, and Shock. Can you guess what it is? 
 New Holiday-themed Weapons: A festive new weapon brand inspired by various holidays is on the way! Stay tuned—we’ll continue to add weapons to this lineup in future updates. 
 Get ready for a snowball fight: With snowy weather comes a new favor from Unibot Residents! But be warned—if you throw a snowball at your robot neighbors, they’ll definitely retaliate! Sparks, you might even ignite a town-wide clash! 
 Multiplayer Ping System: Highlight specific items—like Armor and Health pickups—along with chests and weapons during combat to guide your friends! 
 Updated BuddyOS: We’re adding a new Armory section, similar to the Bot-O-Pedia, that showcases Weapons and Weapon Mods! View the stats and details of all your collected gear in one place. 
 Weapons & Mods Filtering: Overwhelmed by all your gear and wish some items could be left out of the rotation during mission runs? No problem! We’re introducing a new system in the Armory that lets you “ban” specific purchases—a feature highly requested by the community! 
 A ton of new combat areas: We’re introducing day/night variants and new remixes for mission maps, effectively doubling the playable areas within the current biomes! 
 New Character Customization options: We’ve added eight new eyebrow styles to give players even more ways to personalize their characters! 
 And, as always, expect more bug fixes, optimization improvements, and more! 


Thank you for supporting Lynked: Banner of the Spark during Early Access! We’re excited to continue building and expanding the game with the community in 2025. If you haven’t yet, join our Discord server—it’s the best place to share feedback, report bugs, and connect directly with the developers. 

See you in the game!

notes.title: Lynked Patch Notes 11/19
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/2bbaa3cea031b666016de83612340ad30be32b0c.png

Hi, everyone! Today, we’re excited to release our first full patch for Lynked: Banner of the Spark! While we’ve rolled out a few hotfixes since launching into Early Access on October 22, this patch is significantly larger (and just the first of many—check out our latest Development Update to learn more.)

Read on to find out what’s new and what’s changed!

HIGHLIGHTS

➤ NEW FEATURE: Offline Mode
Offline Mode is now available for testing! Please note that if you’d like to sync any progress made in Offline Mode to the cloud, you must first log in. Because of this, we advise against using Offline Mode on multiple devices simultaneously, as this could lead to issues when reconciling save files, potentially causing a loss of progress made during that session. (Offline Mode is still in development, so we're actively working on additional features to improve cloud and local save file management options.)

➤ NOW AVAILABLE: Early Access Freebies
We intended to release these appreciation rewards at our Early Access launch, so we're happy to announce that they're now available in-game. Thank you for your patience and apologies for the delay!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/02f58fe55fbec266ec1a0dcb63f7a0f9662cb561.png

WHAT'S NEW

Expanded Bot-o-Pedia: Now includes a new session about the Combots!
Shared resources in co-op: Combot materials, Heartdrives, and Soulsparks collected in combat are now shared between all players at the end of a multiplayer mission. 
New Sprint options: A toggle option has been added for the “Sprint” button in the Settings menu, and can be configured separately for each input scheme (controller vs. keyboard). Additionally, holding the “Dodge” button will now only keep Sprint active while it’s held. 
Updated character customization screen: Will now better showcase unique outfit variants.
The Smeats have evolved: These quirky little protein analogs can now talk!
Performance and optimization improvements: We’ve made several updates that should significantly improve how well the game runs on more machines. 
Plus, tons of bug fixes: See below!

GAMEPLAY CHANGES 
COMBAT

 Sludge (Status Effect): Sludge-affected players experience a 50% reduction in movement speed, and NPC actions are also significantly slowed under its effects. 
 Gunner Hound (Cyberus): Increased damage of minigun bullets. 
 Hits taken while Overshield (Spark Power) is active no longer reset the player’s K.O. streak. 

MINIBOSSES

 We’ve adjusted the behavior of all Minibosses in Lynked, increasing their aggression, introducing new moves and combos, and rebalancing their health. 
 Miniboss Armor is now adjusted based on player count and threat level. For example, Minibosses in 1-Star single player missions have less Armor compared to those in 4-Star multiplayer missions. 

TOWN

 The daily seed count in Ivy's Shop has been significantly reduced. 
 Fruit sell prices have been increased. 
 Tree seeds prices have been increased. 
 Tehra's Town Passive "Seed Sale" upgrade now increases seed counts at a much lower rate. 
 Increased the pricing for some of Tehra and Ghust's Banner of the Spark Town Passive upgrades.

BUG FIXES

 Fixed the framing on some Unibot icons.
 Fixed the Strawberry grow time to match other crops.
 Fixed issues with certain decor items being placed against walls.
 Fixed the “Splash Bomb” Weapon Mod (Basher) in multiplayer.
 Fixed an exploit with “Crit of the Spark,” “Core of the Spark,” and similar Weapon Mods that allowed two guaranteed procs instead of one.
 Fixed an issue where players were unable to refund Friendchips or Soulsparks, regardless of the number of Heartdrives they had.
 Fixed an issue where players were unable to select a “Support-Lynk” in the loadout cart during contracts with the “No Spark Powers” mutator.
 Reduced texture memory usage and shader instruction count, improving performance in town and several Logwood Pines combat levels.
Plus several other small fixes and optimization/performance improvements.


Thank you once again for supporting Lynked: Banner of the Spark during Early Access! If you haven’t already, we encourage you to join our official Discord server—it’s the best place to share feedback, report bugs, and hear directly from the developers.

See you in the game!

notes.title: Developer Update #2: 2024 Roadmap
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

My name’s Tatyana Dyshlova, and I’m one of the co-founders of FuzzyBot Games. 

Last month, we released Lynked: Banner of the Spark in Early Access (!!!) and—ever since—our focus has been on building and improving the game alongside our community. So, for our second developer update, we thought it’d be nice to check in on how that’s going, digging into two very specific areas:


 What we’ve learned (a big THANK YOU to everyone who’s provided feedback so far 🙏)
 And, based on that information, what we’re working on next

But first, before we dive into the details, here’s a high-level roadmap for Lynked which covers our planned beats through Early 2025. This is a snapshot of what you can expect from the game and team over the next few months as we work to address your wishes, frustrations, ideas, and more.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/3874206ac7dcc2d5e15dbd52d4e906472b1637ce.png

To understand what’s informed this roadmap and what else will be included in each beat, keep reading!

WHAT WE’VE LEARNED
Your feedback during Early Access has been absolutely invaluable, and we use a number of different tools and techniques to capture it—things like in-game telemetry, reports submitted to our Player Support Team, posts made on our Steam forums and in our Discord server, commentary from livestreamers and their chats, mentions we see shared across social media, and (last but certainly not least) the reviews you leave right on this platform. 

Over the last four weeks, we’ve been pouring over all this data, looking for popular topics, themes, and trends that will help guide our production priorities and creative resources to make sure we’re evolving Lynked in the ways that matter most to you. Here are our takeaways!

What’s Working Well

 Visuals and Atmosphere: Based on your feedback, it seems like we’re generally in a great place vibes-wise. You like the game’s colorful, vibrant art style as well as its collection of playable and non-playable characters alike. 
 Co-op Play: Many of you have called out Lynked’s cooperative multiplayer as an overall positive. More often than not, you think it’s a fun and seamless experience that adds layers of replayability and social enjoyment on top of an otherwise solid core loop. 
 Combat System: On the flip side, we’ve seen a lot of notes that Lynked’s in-game combat system feels pretty good—that it’s smooth and engaging, provides satisfying combos, and offers a variety of weapons and upgrades that allow for diverse play styles.
 Variety of Activities: Beyond combat, you seem to enjoy additional activities like fishing (!!!), catching critter-bots, and town building, all of which add depth and delight. 
 Building and Customization: Speaking of town-building, you also seem to really like the game’s broad options for decorating houses and personal spaces.
 Unique Genre Mix: We’ve seen quite a few comments about Lynked’s combination of hack-and-slash combat vs.cozy town-building, noting that it feels like a good mix of some of your favorite genres and games. (Whoever said that Lynked is “Animal Crossing x Hades,” we love you forever. That is a compliment we not only intend to earn, but also one we’ll take with us to our graves.) 

What Could Be Better

 Minor Bugs: As an Early Access title, we’ve had our fair share of bugs— including crashes, unresponsive controls, and inventory glitches (some of which have been fixed, and some of which still require attention and resolution). 
 Performance Issues & Crashes: We continue to receive reports regarding optimization-related problems, such as frame rate drops and high CPU usage, especially in multiplayer. 
 Difficulty Balance: This is an area without clear consensus, but we do know some of you feel the game is either too easy or too difficult, particularly in missions. The lack of a difficulty system, which could offer more challenge (or accommodate different skill levels) is often mentioned in tandem. 
 Gameplay Flow: We’ve seen comments and posts about delays in loot drops, limited interaction range with items, and slow harvesting mechanics disrupting overall pacing.
 Controls and UI: We’ve also seen comments about Lynked’s counterintuitive controls and inconsistent button mappings, which some players find confusing or cumbersome.
 Repetitive Missions: Some players have expressed that, over time, missions can become repetitive and feel like they lack depth (and that they desire more variety in enemy encounters and mission objectives).

What You’d Love To See


 Difficulty Scaling: Option(s) to increase mission difficulty with better rewards.
 Mission Replay Option: Ability to replay missions with varied rewards.
 Improved Controls and UI: A more intuitive controller mapping and smoother UI transitions, like using ESC consistently for menu navigation.
 Enhanced Gameplay Mechanics: Auto-loot, replayable missions, and an evasion mechanic.
 Enhanced Combat Variety: More abilities, weapon options, and mission objectives to keep the combat experience fresh.
 Enhanced Pet System: Functional pets with skills like auto-loot and health recovery. Requests to deploy bots as pets or companions to assist in combat or provide utility functions.
 Expanded NPC Interactions: More engaging and dynamic NPC interactions.
 Streamlined Harvesting: Bulk harvesting tools and faster interaction for crops.
 Improved Multiplayer Systems: Shared loot in co-op and a clearer interface for multiplayer. Town permissions to enable safer usage of public towns.
 More Customization: Expanded options for character, house, and pet customization.
 Optimized Performance: Improvements in overall performance, responsiveness, and stability (particularly in multiplayer and across multiple specs). 
 Frequent Updates and Fixes: Continued bug fixes, quality-of-life updates, and new content releases to enhance the game's longevity.
 Additional Game Content: More mission types, environment diversity, and story elements to increase replayability.
 Additional Feature & Platform Support: Steam Deck, Offline Mode, etc.

WHAT WE’RE WORKING ON
November 2024
This month, we’re looking to drop our first Quality of Life (or “QoL”) patch.

For Lynked, QoL patches will typically be smaller in scope, but the trade-off is that they’re easier and quicker for us to implement. So, while our November patch won’t include any new content, it will include some minor fixes, optimizations, adjustments, and additions that should improve your overall in-game experience. Here are the highlights: 


 Continued bug and crash fixes
 Continued performance optimizations 
 Shared multiplayer loot
 Improved Sprint options
 Upgraded Minibosses 
 Expanded Bot-o-Pedia
 Combat and Town tuning
 Offline Mode
 And more…

December 2024
Next month, we’ll be releasing our first major update! 

This update will be larger in scope than our November patch and will include new content, systems, and features (in addition to continued fixes, optimizations, and tuning). It will also be Winter themed, which means you can expect a feast of festive items to collect. Here’s a first look: 


 Continued bug and crash fixes
 Continued performance optimizations 
 New Unibot
 New Weapon Core
 New weather system
 Multiplayer ping system
 More customization options (including holiday decor and weapons)
 Improved new player experience 
 And more…

Early 2025
As we head into the new year, our exact production calendar becomes a little more nebulous (since we’re still  building out our long-term plans as well as designing / testing out corresponding content). 

That said, you can expect us to continue to release QoL patches and 1-2 major updates in 2025 before our worldwide launch. We look forward to providing more information in the near future, but until then… Here’s a sneak peek at what’s on the horizon:


 Official pet system 
 Lunar New Year-themed freebies
 Official Steam Deck support
 Additional language support
 And more…

To Be Determined…
Beyond what we’ve listed here, there are a variety of other features, systems, and improvements we want to implement based on player feedback, but that we haven’t slotted into our roadmap just yet. 

While it’s our hope to be able to check each of these off our development checklist as soon as possible, we don’t have any estimated dates to assign to them right now. As a result, we may be able to get to some during Early Access, but others may come after our full release. (We’ll, of course, keep you posted!) Here are a few top items on our backlog: 


 New biomes
 Difficulty scaling
 Streamlined harvesting 
 Replayable missions 
 More favor types and status effects
 Additional multiplayer systems
 And more…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/1603bdf72f07efb155d18d1239f6bf89d96bd0ea.png

If you’ve made it this far: We salute you! 

And we hope this update has shed some useful light on what we’ve been working on as a team as well as how your feedback impacts and influences our design decisions. We look forward to sharing even more of these kinds of updates—and another roadmap!—with you early next year. 

Speaking of feedback…

If you haven’t already, we’d love for you to take our Q4 2024 Community Survey! 

As noted earlier, your feedback has helped us make Lynked better than ever, so we wanted to give you a more direct and dedicated space to share your thoughts. Your responses will help us better understand our community and, more importantly, identify the areas of the game that could use our attention. (PS - This survey is open to EVERYONE, too—even if you haven’t played or purchased yet.)


---

Thank you so much for your support, enthusiasm, and candor! Game development can be hard, but we feel so lucky to be creating Lynked: Banner of the Spark for and with each of you. Here’s to many (many) more months of brawling, building, and befriending. 


- Tatyana Dyshlova and the FuzzyBot Development Team

notes.title: Developer Update #1: Welcome to Lynked!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/7ee06319da252325400fafd61d02d05d711bce45.png

Hey everyone, 

My name’s Max. And in late 2020, a few of my fellow developers – Tatyana Dyshlova, Jake Warmerdam, Kevin Lin, and Andy Konieczny – and I left the world of AAA development to form our own studio: FuzzyBot Games.

When the five of us started at FuzzyBot, our first collective feeling was “holy ($(%, what the hell did we just do?" Eventually, we moved past our elder millennial existential panic and settled into an energy we still feel to this day, and that was one of profound joy – to be working together as a team and to have a shot creating a game of our very own. This was our opportunity to build a brighter, more uplifting game experience -- one inspired by all the years we spent as kids in front of our Super Nintendo and Sega Genesis consoles, but modernized and made relevant for gamers of today.

Now, four years later, FuzzyBot remains an intentionally small studio. But our first title, Lynked: Banner of the Spark, is a BIG game! With its variety of complex, interlocking systems -- from environmental combat to robot fishing to player customization, online multiplayer, and more – our team of 25 has aspired to punch above our weight since day one…and we will continue to do so throughout Early Access into the 1.0 launch and beyond.

We're nervous, excited, a little delirious, and extremely proud to share this game with you! We can’t wait to listen to your thoughts, ideas, and stories, and to keep working hard to improve and expand on this game with you moving forward.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/774f15005a7a01e28b3ce796a511f52525d6a30c.jpg

WHAT TO EXPECT FROM EARLY ACCESS

While we only recently revealed Lynked to the world (a whole two months ago!), it was important to us to get the game into your hands sooner rather than later -- and that's by design. By leveraging Early Access on Steam,  we can get real feedback from real players when it matters most. We can listen to your discussions, learn from your experiences, and start incorporating your feedback into the additions and changes we're planning for launch, which will help us create a better game for everyone.

With this initial release, you can expect many hours of robot-crushing, wyre-ripping, weapon-upgrading, and fish-collecting fun. We've probably missed a few not-so-fun bugs here and there, but our team is quick to respond, so you can expect us to be fixing issues throughout Early Access. (And on that note: We've got some neat quality-of-life improvements already in the works and will be sharing more info with all of you soon!)

In addition to your standard fixes and QoL improvements, we also plan to add new content during Early Access later this year. We’re excited to talk about those plans in the coming weeks, but…between now and then, we’d love to hear from the community about what YOU want to see! Let us know your wildest dreams, your craziest ideas, your most bizarre “what if?”s…and maybe we'll be able to turn them into something cool for launch. (Who knows?! We don't! But we’ll try our best to make it work.)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157739/bb91b6fcba811f9cdc6a85816af0143714372714.jpg

With all that said, all of us here at FuzzyBot hope you enjoy playing Lynked: Banner of the Spark as much as we’ve had making it. We still have a long road to launch, but the journey is so much better now that you’re a part of it. Thanks so much for joining us (and, more importantly, our robot revolution). 

(PS - If you haven’t already, feel free to stop by our official Discord. We’d love to chat with you!)

- Max Spielberg and the FuzzyBot Development Team
